sites.name: Burj Khalifa
sites.fact: The tallest building in the world at 828 metres. It opened in 2010.
sites.hint: The needle that stands far above everything else downtown.

sites.name: Palm Jumeirah
sites.fact: An artificial island in the shape of a palm tree, built in the early 2000s from sand dredged from the sea floor.
sites.hint: The palm-shaped island off the coast, south-west of the centre.

sites.name: Burj Al Arab
sites.fact: A hotel shaped like a sail, 321 metres tall, on its own small island. It opened in 1999.
sites.hint: The white sail just off the beach, between the Palm and downtown.

sites.name: Dubai Marina
sites.fact: A canal city about three kilometres long, cut inland from the sea and lined with residential towers.
sites.hint: The winding waterway among towers, south of the Palm.

sites.name: Dubai Frame
sites.fact: A 150-metre picture frame with a glass-floored bridge across the top, opened in 2018. One side looks to old Dubai and the other to new.
sites.hint: A golden rectangle standing in a park, north-east of downtown.

sites.name: Dubai Creek
sites.fact: The saltwater inlet where the city began as a trading and pearl-diving port. Wooden abra boats still ferry people across.
sites.hint: The winding inlet through the old town in the north-east.

sites.name: Museum of the Future
sites.fact: A ring-shaped building covered in Arabic calligraphy, opened in 2022.
sites.hint: A silver ring beside the main highway, north of the Burj Khalifa.

sites.name: Ain Dubai
sites.fact: The tallest observation wheel in the world, about 250 metres high, on Bluewaters Island.
sites.hint: The giant wheel on a small island off the Marina.

sites.name: Dubai International Airport
sites.fact: One of the busiest airports in the world for international passengers.
sites.hint: East of the creek, at the north-east corner of the city.

sites.name: The World Islands
sites.fact: About 300 artificial islands arranged as a map of the world, four kilometres off the coast. Most remain undeveloped.
sites.hint: A scatter of sandy islands out at sea, north-west of downtown.

sites.name: Jumeirah Mosque
sites.fact: Built of white stone in 1979 in a style inspired by Fatimid Egypt, and open to visitors of all faiths.
sites.hint: Near the coast, north of downtown.

sites.name: Atlantis The Palm
sites.fact: The resort at the outer edge of the Palm's crescent, opened in 2008.
sites.hint: The pink building with a great arch, at the far tip of the Palm.
